messages.author: 6221508b504c7427
messages.subject: lavaan output with xtable()
parts:
Dear lavaan Users,

There are some packages in R for generating outputs with table format
based on Latex. lavaan's outputs do not seem to be transformed into a
Latex style output. xtable() in xtable package does not work at all, for
example. Do you have any idea to transform lavaan's outputs into Latex
style's tables. Thank you in advance.

best,

Jong-Hwa

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan output with xtable()
parts:
On 11/07/2012 05:16 AM, SHIN Jong-Hwa wrote:
> Dear lavaan Users,
>
> There are some packages in R for generating outputs with table format
> based on Latex. lavaan's outputs do not seem to be transformed into a
> Latex style output. xtable() in xtable package does not work at all, for
> example. Do you have any idea to transform lavaan's outputs into Latex
> style's tables. Thank you in advance.

The output of the 'summary()' function will not work with xtable.
However, the parameterEstimates() function returns a data.frame, which
is supported by xtable. This works rather well:

> library(lavaan)
> library(xtable)
> example(> xtable(parameterEstimates(fit))

messages.author: 4be6067b92d51772
messages.subject: Re: lavaan output with xtable()
parts:
Dear Jong-Hwa and colleagues,

 

I want to consult with you that whether there is a package which can produce ASCII text for well-formatted tables from SEM analysis with lavaan. I find stargazer works well with other packages like lme4 and nlme. But I am not sure whether it is compatible with lavaan. Do you have any ideas?

 

Best,

Chuding
